description: This file contains Go source code implementing read transaction interfaces and types for a storage backend, specifically for the etcd project. It defines interfaces, structs, and methods related to read transactions, including safe range and iteration functions, with concurrency control mechanisms.

classes.name: baseReadTx
classes.description: Base struct for read transactions, managing concurrency, buffer, and bucket cache.

classes.name: readTx
classes.description: Read transaction type embedding baseReadTx with locking methods.

classes.name: concurrentReadTx
classes.description: Concurrent read transaction type embedding baseReadTx with no locking, suitable for concurrent use.

methods.name: UnsafeForEach
methods.description: Iterates over all key-value pairs in a bucket, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: UnsafeRange
methods.description: Returns a range of keys and values from a bucket, with safety checks and cache optimization.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the transaction for exclusive access.
